verification_notes.note: Factual correction: Total deposits grew by EUR 1,179 million (+21% YoY) to EUR 6.9 billion, not EUR 990 million. The EUR 990 million figure incorrectly duplicates the loan portfolio growth amount from D2. Revised to reflect actual deposit growth of EUR 1,179 million (rounded to EUR 1.18 billion in reporting).

Updated reference_support to true: Strategic initiatives (UK retail banking launch, mobile app, cost-control/restructuring) are factually supported by CEO letter (page 8), LHV Bank Ltd overview (page 25), and Management report development activities (page 22). Source evidence sufficiently covers all claimed initiatives.

redundancy_check.note: All final units target distinct material themes: financial performance (K1), loan portfolio (K2), deposits (K3), assets under management (K4), customer base (K5), strategic initiatives (K6), dividend policy (K7), regulatory capital (K8), and macroeconomic context (K9). No unit evaluates the same core fact or substitutes for another.

key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue increased by 11% to EUR 338.3 million in 2024, driven by net interest income growth of 8% to EUR 273.3 million and net fee and commission income growth of 24% to EUR 60.3 million; net profit rose 7% to EUR 150.3 million, resulting in a cost-to-income ratio of 43.4% and return on equity of 24.5%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (pages 10-11); Consolidated statement of profit or loss (page 189)

key_information_units.information: The loan portfolio expanded by EUR 990 million (28% YoY) to EUR 4.6 billion, comprising Estonian corporate loans up 21% to EUR 2.3 billion, Estonian retail loans up 21% to EUR 1.9 billion, and UK SME loans up 338% to EUR 0.3 billion.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 12, Loans and advances to customers (page 223)

key_information_units.information: Deposits grew by EUR 1,179 million (21% YoY) to EUR 6.9 billion, with regular customer deposits in LHV Pank rising EUR 554 million (14% YoY to EUR 4.6 billion) and deposits from financial intermediaries increasing significantly (LHV Bank collections up EUR 416 million, +388% YoY), partly offset by LHV Pank reducing platform deposits by one-third.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 17, Deposits from customers (page 226)

key_information_units.information: Assets under management increased to EUR 1.56 billion (3% YoY), primarily due to positive market returns, with LHV Varahaldus maintaining a ~25% market share in Estonia's II pillar pension system managing savings for 22.3% of participants.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Overview of LHV Varahaldus (page 24)

key_information_units.information: Customer base grew with LHV Pank reaching 456,000 clients (+9% YoY, including 38,000 new customers), and LHV Kindlustus insuring 170,000 customers (+6% YoY).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Overview of LHV Kindlustus (page 24)

key_information_units.information: Strategic initiatives included launching retail banking operations in the UK, introducing a mobile banking app, and implementing cost-control measures involving redundancies and departmental restructuring to enhance operational efficiency.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO (page 8); Overview of LHV Bank Ltd (page 25); Management report, Development activities (page 22)

key_information_units.information: The dividend proposal recommends paying EUR 0.09 per share (total EUR 29.2 million) with related income tax of EUR 8.2 million, and transferring EUR 123.2 million of parent-company attributable profit to retained earnings.

The Group maintained strong regulatory capital positions with a CET1 ratio of 16.89% (above minimum 12.41%), complying with all capital adequacy (including MREL of 33.24% and 12.41%), leverage ratio (6.71%), and liquidity requirements (LCR 187.5%, NSFR 154.4%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Regulatory and financial ratios (page 13); Note 21, Shareholders' equity (page 230)

key_information_units.information: Operations occurred amid a contracting Estonian economy (GDP -0.7% YoY) and stabilized UK economy, with LHV Pank maintaining tight credit quality (loans overdue >60 days at 0.3% of portfolio) and benefiting from rising corporate loan demand late in the year.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Business environment (page 18); Market average share of overdue loans (page 20); Overview of LHV Pank (page 21)
